Investors from the United Arab Emirates are leading the round alongside Coatue,

title: Disgraced eMudhra drops out of TLS business after using cert private key of 4
title_en: Disgraced eMudhra drops out of TLS business after using cert private key of 4
author: Ars Technica
content_snippet:
eMudra, the certificate authority that issued eight intermediate TLS credentials so weak that anyone could mint certificates for any website or mail server—one had a private encryption key of just 4—said it’s getting out of the business.

summary_en: Embattled certificate authority eMudhra has announced its complete withdrawal from the global SSL/TLS market after a catastrophic security failure. The agency previously issued intermediate TLS credentials so fatally misconfigured that one private key was literally set to the single digit '4', allowing malicious actors to forge spoofed certificates. Facing intense industry backlash and irrecoverable reputational damage, the company cited regulatory burdens and marginal revenue as its rationale for shutting down the unit.

title: Discord now formats Markdown previews right
title_en: Discord now formats Markdown previews right
author: The Verge AI
content_snippet:

author: Bloomberg
content_snippet: Venture capitalists are fighting to invest in AI startup Emulate, driving its valuation into the billions …

title_en: GitLab patches a critical flaw that lets unauthenticated attackers run code on self-managed servers, affecting every release since 7.0 in 2014 (Swati Khandelwal/The Hacker News)
author: The Hacker News
content_snippet:
GitLab released fixes on October 21 for a flaw that lets an attacker run code on a self-managed server without logging in, and it affects every version of the software going back to 7.0, released in 2014.

The fix matters even for administrators who patched nine days earlier: the October 12 update covered only versions 19.2 and later, and the new fixed versions sit one patch above it, so an instance updated then is in range again.

The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-110264, is rated 10.0 on the CVSS

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 马克·扎克伯格在监管披露文件中透露，若加利福尼亚州下月投票通过针对亿万富翁征收5%一次性财产税的提案，他正考虑迁出该州。加州选民将在即将到来的公投中对该法案进行表决。扎克伯格此举主要是为了规避潜在的数十亿美元巨额个人税务负担，并向当地立法机构施加政策压力。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Mark Zuckerberg disclosed in a regulatory filing that he is considering leaving California if the state passes a proposed one-time 5% wealth tax on billionaires in next month's ballot. The measure, which California voters will soon decide on, faces stiff resistance from Silicon Valley leaders seeking to protect their assets. The move underscores growing tensions between tech elites and progressive tax policies in the state.
